name: Tim Radford, President - WKRK
quote: I looked long and hard to find a production company with the professional voices and delivery that sounded exciting for my listeners to hear, yet at a price that was within my budget. I was looking for talent on my commercials... not just rip and read of the script. Delivery speed, too, was a factor. With the promise of overnight delivery via mp3 to my email AND professionally written commercials, I believe I've found the best choice. I'm excited to have Overnight Radio Productions on my team!
I send in a creative request, and the VERY NEXT Day I have my clients spot. Quick, AND top notch.
With your variety of voices, our ad clusters have more colour, and our station sounds bigger.

name: Bruce Walchuk, Station Manager - CKDR
quote: The first Spec Spot that ORP did for us generated a sale that paid for the service for the next three months-from a customer who didn't want to use radio. Bottom line - Overnight Radio WORKS, and it's added to our bottom line since the first time we used them. We are believers!

name: Lorna Markiewich – GAB Wireless
quote: Always excited to hear your creations – we’ve been getting a ton of compliments – great work!
